label: D1 dip after a1 reached rare S2, deeper if repeated and late in episode
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * ((tv("action", -2) == 1) & (tv("state", -2) == 2)) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (1 - belief) ;; (phase != D1) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 43 sits near 1 (keep the old hidden state) and only drops at D1. The drop comes after the previous trial was a1 that reached the rare state S2: about -0.10 if it was unrewarded, -0.05 if rewarded. It gets about 0.045 deeper if the trial before was also a1->S2, and deeper still later in the episode (about -0.008 per episode decile). At D1 it is slightly higher after reaching S1 (+0.027), lower after unrewarded a1 trials when belief favours S2, and it falls a little as the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good rises. GO and D2 barely vary; only a tiny belief term there. No future, hidden or model-output variables are used. Dev R^2 beyond timing is 0.69. The reference scores are 0.66 for the last-trial table alone, 0.71 for all observed cues and 0.74 for all cues; the model-based policy decile alone was 0.36, so using only observed quantities loses essentially nothing. Residual errors: D1 dips on a window first trial, where the previous trial is not in the window.

issues: Minor: the quoted effect sizes are partial coefficients from correlated terms, not the size of the dip itself. The raw D1 residuals are -0.165 after a1 S2 u and -0.098 after a1 S2 r. The fitted -0.105 / -0.051 only add up to that once the ep_dec term (-0.008 per decile, also applied to a1->S2) and the (prev_action==1)(prev_reward==0)(1-belief) term (-0.026) are included. The weights are unstable: dropping last_is('a1 S2 u') flips the a1 S2 r weight to +0.02 and the fit still reaches test R^2 0.62. So the numbers in the explanation should not be read as standalone dip sizes.

Reproduced the result: test R^2 beyond timing is 0.684. Dropping one term at a time on test gives: a1S2u 0.62, (prev_state==1) 0.63, D1 belief_lo 0.65, ep_dec*a1S2 0.668, a1S2r 0.671, repeat 0.675, a1-unrewarded*(1-belief) 0.679. Dropping (phase!=D1)*belief_lo also lands at about 0.68, so that term adds only about 0.005. Every claimed effect contributes, with the sign stated.

The remaining misses are the error class the explanation already names. The worst windows are D1 dips of about -0.3 on a window's first trial, where the previous trial is missing. Adding (prev_action==-1)*ep_dec adds 0.000. Besides these there are a few isolated late-episode D1 dips after a2 S2 unrewarded (t83, t85, t97). A last_is('a2 S2 u')*ep_dec term adds nothing (0.683), and the mean residual for that cell is +0.006, so this is not systematic. The mean error by phase x previous trial is at most 0.016 in every cell (D1 after a2 S1 u is over-predicted by 0.016).

Eight replacement terms all came within +/-0.002 of 0.684 on test: a1S2 x belief_lo, a1S2 x belief, a1S2 x (ep_dec>=8), a1S2u x repeat, a1S2 x (10-belief_cover), (prev_state==2)(prev_reward==0) x belief_lo, an a1-on-the-trial-before term, and a D2 a1->S2 term. Given the 0.71 ceiling for all observed cues, no large systematic gap remains.

Claims checked as consistent: GO and D2 barely vary (their residual tables are at most about 0.01). The gate is higher at D1 after reaching S1 (residuals +0.016 to +0.028). It falls as belief rises (D1 by belief decile goes from +0.026 to -0.047). The claim that going observed-only loses little is fair: 0.684 against an observed ceiling of 0.71 and an all-cue ceiling of 0.74, and no future, hidden or model-output variables are used.
